free_text: The decision to recommend biopsy is supported by convergence across all inputs. The guideline criterion mandates re-biopsy for a PI-RADS 4 lesion, which was retrieved, combined with the rising PSA trend (from 6.5 to 9.2 ng/mL) and the prior negative biopsy status. The statistical prior also suggested biopsy, and the PI-RADS 4 score was decisive in this context. The evidence strongly supports proceeding with targeted sampling.
